author: gurukamath
content:
🧪  `bogota-devnet@v1.1.1`: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-bogota-devnet@v1.1.1

We are using this EELS branch for reference: [`devnets/bogota/1`](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/devnets/bogota/1)

PTAL at the release notes & the test [release tracker](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/3727) for the full scope.
**Patch release: no consensus change** since v1.1.0, only new tests, fixture formats, client mappings and the latest `forks/bogota`.

**New in v1.1.1:**
- EIP-8141: blob-carrying frame transactions, `BLOBHASH`/`TXPARAM` blob fields in every frame mode, shared block blob limit, network-wrapper rejection in block bodies, and execute-only `engine_getBlobsV*` round trips (#3824).
- EIP-8141: `frame_tx` variants of earlier-fork tests now also fill as `blockchain_test_engine_x` fixtures (#3877).
- EIP-8250: execute-only blob round trip on fresh non-zero nonce keys, from an EOA and a contract sender; pools must track the keys' sequences, not the account nonce (#3825).
- EIP-7906: `BLOBHASH` in a `POST_TX` frame (#3824 backport).
- Reth error mappings for frame, keyed nonce and `POST_TX` rejections (#3826).
- Base: `forks/bogota` through #3874, incl. rejection of empty/`0xff`-prefixed tx bytes (#3861) and legacy chain ids over 64 bits (#3828).
